title: Self-Destruct Mechanism
caption: Self-Destruct Mechanism (V)
game_text: If your droid was just hit by a character weapon, lose that droid to target the character that fired that weapon. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit -4 if destiny +3 > defense value.
lore: “’Fraid there’s not much left. . . I didn’t hit it that hard; it musta had a self-destruct.”

notes: Non-unique. The crop cuts off the slip's heading (bottom halves of the letters only); title and caption read from the bottom strip. 'hit' is printed without quotes on the slip. It musta'); the closing '.”' is read at 367 px and could be '”' alone. The wiki's default 'Self-Destruct Mechanism' page links the archive face; the 350 px Hoth-D-selfdestructmechanism.gif is the 'E' errata face (downloaded, not used); printed face = 'Self-Destruct Mechanism (Original)' → Hoth-D-selfdestructmechanism-decipher-archive.gif (367×506) used. Modern: VB2 -pre (350) used; non-pre (identical bytes) also downloaded; no V-set remake exists. Copyright 1996 (Hoth), not legible at 367 px.
